title: Entity set
description: JSON Schema for an entity-set E: a finite collection of distinct entity-slugs over which predication fiber algebras index via E × E. The set carries no required structure beyond set-hood; finiteness here is a JSON-Schema artifact and matches the finite-entity hypothesis used throughout the predication category theory.

entities.description: The elements of E as kebab-case slugs. Each slug must individually conform to the entity schema (slug-pattern check inlined here for self-containment).

sorts.description: Optional sort partition. Map from sort-slug to the list of entity-slugs in that sort. Every value-slug must appear in entities.
